# Handyman Direct

> South African marketplace that connects homeowners with verified tradespeople — plumbers, electricians, builders, painters, roofers and more. Homeowners post a job for free; contractors pay credits to quote.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the service, how it works, and featured trades.
- [Post a job](/book): Job posting form for homeowners.
- [For contractors](/contractors): Information and signup for tradespeople.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about hiring, payments, and verification.
